question.question_text: What steps did the camera wearer take to prepare for the foundation work that involved spreading concrete and laying bricks?

answer_options.text: Sit down and clean hands, pour concrete on the ground, dig with a shovel, and stack bricks next to the foundation.
Lean back and wipe face, pour concrete into a formwork, excavate with a combined hoe and fork, and align bricks on the foundation.
Lean back and wipe face, spread concrete on the ground, dig with a combined hoe and fork, and place bricks on the foundation.
Lean back and wipe face, spread concrete on the ground, and place bricks on the foundation.
Lean back and wipe face, spread concrete on the ground, dig with a combined hoe and fork, place bricks on the foundation, and measure the level of the foundation.

shared_investigation.established_facts: The camera wearer places bricks on the ground, adjusts them with hands, measures placement using a string line, and taps bricks into place with a hammer. They also use a trowel to spread concrete and dig soil, and they dig with a shovel and spade. The camera wearer places bricks on the foundation, adjusts them, and uses a trowel to spread concrete around them. They also measure the ground with a tape measure and use a mallet to tap bricks into place.

evidence_index.source_content: Camera wearer places bricks on ground, adjusts them with hands, measures placement using string line, and taps bricks into place with hammer.
Camera wearer uses trowel to smooth concrete and dig soil; picks up and puts down trowel multiple times.
Camera wearer adjusts bricks, uses mallet to tap them into place, and pulls/holds string line for alignment.
Camera wearer places and adjusts bricks, hits with hammer, pulls string line, pours sand into hole, and digs soil with spade.
Camera wearer spreads cement on ground and wall using trowel and bucket, pulls string line, places brick on concrete, and smooths concrete around it.
Camera wearer pours cement into gaps between bricks and spreads evenly with trowel, places brick on ground, adjusts it, and taps with mallet.
Camera wearer measures ground with tape measure, places bricks on concrete mixture, adjusts them, and taps into place with mallet.
Camera wearer picks up brick, places it on ground or wall, scoops and spreads cement with trowel, and hits brick with hammer; repetitive trowel handling.
Camera wearer digs soil with pickaxe and spade, scoops soil with bucket, picks up and throws stones.
Camera wearer places stones and bricks on ground, adjusts positions, spreads cement with trowel, and smooths concrete; repetitive trowel handling.
